name: sui
description: Sui as one mod. On Sui an account address and an object ID are both 32 bytes of hex and nothing tells them apart, so this module starts by asking the chain instead of guessing: give it any string and it says whether you are holding an address, a coin object, an NFT, a shared object, a published package, a transaction digest or a SuiNS name — then answers the question you actually had. Price everything an address holds including staked SUI, which appears in no balance call; decode a transaction into net movement per owner and the Move commands that ran; read a package's callable functions with full type signatures, because Move keeps its interface on chain; read the validator set and the Nakamoto coefficient. It writes too: transfers of SUI and any coin type are simulated, then signed in-process with a key from an off-tree keystore. Seventeen MCP tools, a REST API and a browser console run the same code on one port. Note that Mysten's public fullnodes have dropped JSON-RPC entirely — this module keeps a pool of third-party endpoints and fails over between them.

endpoints.transfer: POST /transfer {to, amount, coin_type?, wallet?, dry_run?, confirm?} — write-gated

backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib); BCS transaction building, base58, bech32 and ed25519 implemented in-tree, with a PyNaCl/cryptography fast path when present
transport_note: https://fullnode.mainnet.sui.io answers every JSON-RPC method with 'JSON-RPC on public fullnodes has been deprecated'. The protocol still works on third-party nodes, so the module keeps a pool and fails over; set SUI_RPC to your own node to skip it.

keys.env: SUI_SECRET_KEY — a suiprivkey1… string, base64 flag||seed, hex seed, or a path to a sui.keystore file
keys.scheme: ed25519 only for signing; every scheme is recognised for reading
keys.rule: no house wallet — a transfer signs with a key the caller controls and the seed never leaves the process

auth.writes: Authorization: Bearer <~/.mod/sui/server.secret>; with no secret file the signing routes answer only on loopback

env.PORT: port for API, console and MCP (default 50740)
env.SUI_RPC: default RPC endpoint — set your own when the public pool throttles
env.SUI_SPEND_USD: value guard: a transfer worth more needs confirm=true (default 25)
env.SUI_OFFLINE: skip the tests that need the chain
